$comment: G1 fixed 10-trial manifest (Issue #19; rebuilt 2026-09-21 for the tray layout of ADR 0008). Frozen before the G1 evaluation: its commit hash is recorded on Issue #13 and it is never rewritten afterwards; a change is a new manifest with its reason on #13. Each trial submits the named 4a fixture (contracts/fixtures/4a/<fixture>.json) through PlanRunner.submit after both registered objects were staged at start_xy_m (metres, base frame; z = rest height). The ten start patterns are the table of ADR 0008: the user picked them from a rendered layout on 2026-09-20 and the agent checks them against the geometric rules (plan/manifest.check_manifest) and runs them headless (docs/g1-manifest.md). Both objects move per trial; neither has to be at its registered home.
